title: Egg-allergic kid at a Marsden Park party? One eggless cake for the whole class
summary:
One child at the party can't have egg. With us, that changes nothing: every cake we bake is 100% eggless, so the whole Marsden Park class eats the same slice.

No separate allergy cupcake on a side plate. No reading labels at the table. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream, not in any of the 15 flavours.

A 10-inch serves 20–22, from $74.99, which covers most class parties in Marsden Park, Shanes Park or Riverstone. Custom designs welcome, so send a photo of what they want.

Two days' notice. Pickup from Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking. Another allergy in the group, such as nuts? Tell us when you order and we'll talk through the flavours.
